name: Pool Mosaic
summary: An ivory mosque locks into a cyan stepped pool, making a compact ceramic emblem.
why: The hall and basin meet along y57.45 after a uniform 1.15 enlargement. The water channel is cut out rather than painted over; broad bridges carry the weight of the architecture. The central dome and portal share x60.9, while the left minaret balances the upper composition.
risk: The basin is a graphic water symbol rather than a literal wave. At 24px the dry channel simplifies to a bright division.
sub1: The basin is part of the same tiled composition
sub2: Wide channels survive in a single color
theme: The courtyard pool as a ceramic foundation
reasonToChoose: You want a compact mosque identity with a strong water-and-tile character.
